Messages.Author: Mac User
Messages.Body:
I'm sure somebody can give me an opinion on this, as the rules
don't seem too clear. Is it possible to use multiple strikes of
aggrivated damage? For example, I've got Black Cat equipped
with a flame-thrower (2Rag.) Can she use an Acrobatics to
inflict 4Rag. damage on her opponent, or is the opponent sent
to topor after the first stike (thus making it 'immune')?

On a similar note, is it possible to continue combat with
a press if one or both vampires are going to topor? I
assume that this would not be allowed.

-David Mitchell (mitc...@ncsa.uiuc.edu)

Messages.Author: Thomas R Wylie
Messages.Body:
Mac User <us...@ncsa.uiuc.edu> wrote:
>I'm sure somebody can give me an opinion on this, as the rules
>don't seem too clear. Is it possible to use multiple strikes of
>aggrivated damage? For example, I've got Black Cat equipped
>with a flame-thrower (2Rag.) Can she use an Acrobatics to
>inflict 4Rag. damage on her opponent, or is the opponent sent
>to topor after the first stike (thus making it 'immune')?

Assuming the damage from the first strike wasn't prevented, the vampire
went into torpor, and the combat ended before additional strikes could
be played.

>On a similar note, is it possible to continue combat with
>a press if one or both vampires are going to topor? I
>assume that this would not be allowed.

You're correct, that would not be allowed.

Tom Wylie rec.games.trading-cards.* Network Representative for
aa...@cats.ucsc.edu Wizards of the Coast, Inc.

Messages.Body:

>Mac User <us...@ncsa.uiuc.edu> wrote:
> stuff chopped

>Assuming the damage from the first strike wasn't prevented, the vampire
>went into torpor, and the combat ended before additional strikes could
>be played.

> stuff chopped

IMHO, the vampire inflicting the damage should be able to do what it
likes with the vampire in torpor. After all, the second vampire has just passed
out at the feet of the first, it makes little sense for the first vampire not
to diable (however0 it is spelt, or burn the vampire, after all, it can not
resist. Too bad the rules do not allow it.
